title: A2A v1.0 Agent Card
description: JSON Schema for A2A v1.0 Agent Cards published under .agents/<agent_id>.card.json. Enforces the 5 required A2A top-level fields, the skill item shape, and a closed set of optional capability/security/provider blocks. additionalProperties is false at the top level to prevent silent drift; skills[] items allow additionalProperties for forward compatibility with future A2A revisions.

description.description: One paragraph (two to three sentences) explaining purpose, sensitivity, and trust boundary.

version.description: Semver-shaped version string for the Agent Card itself.

url.description: Transport URI for the agent. A2A v1.0 permits non-HTTP schemes (stdio, tg, custom).

skills.description: Declared agent skills. Each item is snake_case identified with human-friendly metadata.

id.description: Snake case identifier. Colon permitted to namespace per-account variants (gmail_read:main).

securitySchemes.description: Per A2A spec, the value shape is delegated to the agent; this schema enforces type=object only.
